books.title: Marianela
books.author: Benito Pérez Galdós
books.difficultyNote: A full historical novel with older vocabulary. Project Gutenberg reports a reading-ease score of 64.9, described as neither easy nor difficult.
books.description: A compassionate novel about Marianela, a poor young guide, and Pablo, the blind young man who understands the world through her eyes.
books.attribution: Original Spanish text by Benito Pérez Galdós. Paralingo edition derived from Project Gutenberg eBook 17340.

books.title: Contos para a infância
books.author: Abílio Manuel Guerra Junqueiro
books.difficultyNote: Short, episodic children's stories in modern spelling. The vocabulary and moral style remain historical rather than graded beginner Portuguese.
books.description: Forty-three imaginative and moral tales selected for young readers, presented in European Portuguese with modern spelling.
books.attribution: Portuguese collection prepared by Guerra Junqueiro. Paralingo edition derived from Project Gutenberg eBook 16429.

books.title: Le avventure di Pinocchio
books.author: Carlo Collodi
books.difficultyNote: A familiar episodic story, but Project Gutenberg reports a reading-ease score of 55.4 and the Italian remains historical rather than beginner-level.
books.description: The mischievous wooden puppet Pinocchio leaves Geppetto's workshop and learns about courage, responsibility, and becoming human.
books.attribution: Original Italian text by Carlo Collodi. Paralingo edition derived from Project Gutenberg eBook 52484.
